tooltip.bleach.shihakusho_set: Full Shihakushō: +%s%% reiryoku regeneration for Shinigami and Academy students
tooltip.bleach.denreishinki: Beeps when a Garganta opens nearby. Use it to find the nearest Hollow
tooltip.bleach.quincy_cross: Hold use to draw a bow of reishi. It answers only to Quincy blood
tooltip.bleach.quincy_garb_set: Full Quincy garb: +%s%% reishi gathering for Quincy
item.bleach.asauchi.nameless: A nameless blade. It is listening.
screen.bleach.soul.chain.encroaching: Chain of Fate: %s left. Encroachment has begun
screen.bleach.soul.reiatsu.sealed: Reiatsu held in. Press %s to release it
screen.bleach.soul.reiatsu.released: Reiatsu released. Press %s to hold it in
screen.bleach.soul.hunt: Hollows purified: %s · slain: %s · Pluses sent on: %s
screen.bleach.soul.quincy.poison: Hollow poison: %s%% · souls destroyed: %s · reishi here: %s
screen.bleach.soul.next.human: You are alive and can sense spirits. Grow your reiryoku; a Shinigami in need may one day share their power with you. If you die, your soul lingers as a Plus.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.latent: Quincy blood runs in you. Hold use with a Quincy Cross to draw on the reishi around you, or meditate with it in hand, and keep at it (near a Hollow, if you dare) until a bow of light forms.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.1: You are a Quincy. Your Cross forms the Heilig Bogen: hold use to draw, let go to fire. Meditate with the Cross in hand to gather reishi, and destroy Hollows to grow stronger.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.2: Reishi carries you now: the Flash Step key does Hirenkyaku, and you can stand on reishi in mid-air. Call on Blut with its key.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.3: You have mastered the Quincy arts of this age. Your arrows pierce deep. Beware Hollow poison.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.poisoned: Hollow reiatsu is poisoning your soul. Rest and gather reishi where it runs rich, or stand by while a Shinigami purifies a Hollow, before it tears you apart.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute: You are a Substitute Shinigami: alive, with a Shinigami's power. Perform Konsō on Pluses, train your Hohō for Shunpo, and bond with your Asauchi.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute.bonde: Your Asauchi is ready to speak. On solid ground, sneak and hold use with it to sit in Jinzen.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute.named: Call your zanpakutō's name with the Release key to enter Shikai, and keep the town's Pluses safe.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus: Your Chain of Fate is wearing away. Find a Shinigami, or the instructor at the Academy, to perform Konsō before it runs out.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.academy: Your Chain of Fate is wearing away. The Academy lies %s, about %s blocks away: ask its instructor for Konsō before the chain runs out.
screen.bleach.soul.next.rukongai: You have passed on. Souls with spiritual power can enroll at the Academy to train as Shinigami.
screen.bleach.soul.next.student: Train the Zankensoki, then ask the Academy instructor to examine you for graduation.
screen.bleach.soul.next.student.bonded: Your Asauchi has a voice, but you must graduate before you can hear its name.
screen.bleach.soul.next.lent: Your power flowed into a human. It will return in time.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami: Bond with your Asauchi until it tells you its name.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami.bonded: Your Asauchi is ready to speak. On solid ground, sneak and hold use with it to sit in Jinzen.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami.named: Call your zanpakutō's name with the Release key to enter Shikai.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow: The hunger gnaws at you, but there is nothing you can devour yet. The Hollow path comes later.
screen.bleach.soul.next.arrancar: Your true power is sealed inside your zanpakutō.
screen.bleach.bloodline.body: Quincy are born, not made: their power comes down the blood, pure (Echt) or mixed (Gemischt). Is there Quincy blood in you? You are asked once, and it cannot be changed.
screen.bleach.bloodline.human.tooltip: No Quincy blood. Your soul may still find another path
screen.bleach.bloodline.quincy.tooltip: Quincy blood, Echt about one time in four. A Quincy Cross awakens it. An awakened Quincy cannot take a Shinigami's power
screen.bleach.bloodline.fate.tooltip: A small chance of Quincy blood
jinzen.bleach.silent: You sit with the Asauchi across your knees. For now it is only steel.
jinzen.bleach.stirring: Something in the blade turns towards you, then away again.
jinzen.bleach.stirring.name: It tries to tell you its name: %s
jinzen.bleach.vision.power: You glimpse something huge and patient, all muscle and teeth.
jinzen.bleach.vision.kido: You glimpse a cold light that bends the air around it.
jinzen.bleach.vision.constant_release: You glimpse a wind that never stops blowing.
jinzen.bleach.student: A voice speaks from the blade, but a student's soul cannot hold its name yet. Graduate, then come back.
jinzen.bleach.weak: The voice is there, but too faint to follow. Grow your maximum reiryoku to %s and come back.
jinzen.bleach.resting: The spirit has turned its back on you. Come back in %s.
jinzen.bleach.unknown: The world inside the blade is empty. Whatever lived here is gone.
jinzen.bleach.ribbons: Among the white ribbons, one is red: the one that is yours. Take hold of it.
jinzen.bleach.fangs: The jaws close around you. Strike through the gap before they meet.
jinzen.bleach.reveal.name: Its name is %s.
jinzen.bleach.reveal.constant: It has no command. Once you call its name, it will never seal again.
jinzen.bleach.fail.retry: The world fades. You may try again in %s.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.1: You stand on the wall of a tower. The whole city lies on its side under a pale sky.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.2: An old man in a long black coat stands on a flagpole, his coat moving in a wind you cannot feel.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.3: He looks at you as if he has been waiting for years.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.question: Something stronger than you is coming. What do you do?
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.reveal.1: He nods, and the wind over the city falls still.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.fail.1: The old man turns away. Rain begins to fall on the city.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.visit.1: The old man watches the sky. He says nothing, and does not need to.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.intro.1: Thick jungle presses in on every side, loud with insects and running water.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.intro.2: A great baboon watches you from the branches, and a snake coils where its tail should be.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.question: Someone you look up to is far ahead of you. What do you want?
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.reveal.1: The baboon laughs, and the snake hisses along with it.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.fail.1: The baboon loses interest and climbs away into the canopy.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.visit.1: The baboon dozes in the branches. The snake opens one eye.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.living: The Academy trains the souls of the departed, and you still have a body. Some say a Shinigami can pour their power into one of the living. Central 46 executes any Shinigami who does, so do not go looking for one.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.substi: So you are the human who took a Shinigami's power. There is nothing here you would be allowed to learn, but I can spare you a blade.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.plus: Your Chain of Fate still binds you. Before you can study here your soul must pass on. Shall I perform Konsō?
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.soul: You have passed on, and you have spiritual power. The Academy teaches the Zankensoki: Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hohō and Kidō. Will you enroll?
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.studen: Train the four arts, then sit the exams. Kidō rests on reiatsu control, so that is what I test until you can cast.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.shinig: A Shinigami. Your division needs you more than I do.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.hollow: A Hollow, at the Academy? Leave now, before I cut you down.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.quincy: A Quincy. Your kind destroys the souls we are sworn to send on. There is nothing for you here, and the Academy wants no trouble with you.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.offer_pow: A Hollow did this. I drove it off, but I cannot fight like this, and it will be back. You can see me, so you have the strength for this. Take my power. It is forbidden, but I see no other way.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.plus: Your chain is wearing thin. Let me send you on while I still can.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.resting: I will mend. Go, before the Hollow returns.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.quincy: A Quincy... Your soul would never take my power, and I would not give it to you. Go, before the Hollow comes back.
screen.bleach.dialogue.asauchi_not_ready: Only for a soul with no blade, once every ten minutes
message.bleach.became_plus: Your body is gone. You linger where you fell, a Plus bound to this world by your Chain of Fate.
message.bleach.became_plus.elsewhere: Your body is gone, and you could not stay where you fell. You wake as a Plus, bound to this world by your Chain of Fate.
message.bleach.encroachment_begins: The links of your Chain of Fate have begun to eat each other. Encroachment has set in.
message.bleach.encroachment_pang: Your chain gnaws at your chest
message.bleach.hollowfied: Your Chain of Fate is gone. A hole opens in your chest and a mask forms over your face. You have become a Hollow.
message.bleach.reiatsu_too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku to release
message.bleach.power_lent: Your power has not returned yet
message.bleach.became_shinigami: Your body is gone, but the Shinigami power within holds your soul together. You are a Shinigami now.
message.bleach.enrolled: You enroll at the Academy. The instructor hands you an Asauchi, a nameless blade.
message.bleach.asauchi_reissued: The instructor hands you a new Asauchi
message.bleach.asauchi_not_yet: The instructor has no blade to spare yet
message.bleach.graduated: You pass the Academy's exams. You are a Shinigami now.
message.bleach.konso.received: The pommel touches your forehead. Your Chain of Fate falls away and your soul passes on.
message.bleach.konso.untrained: Only a Shinigami can perform Konsō
message.bleach.power.received: Power floods into you and a blade forms in your hands. You are a Substitute Shinigami.
message.bleach.wounded_nearby: You sense a faint, wavering reiatsu nearby. Someone is hurt.
message.bleach.offer.konso: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will be sent to the Academy %s, about %s blocks away.
message.bleach.offer.konso.far: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will be sent to the Academy in the world above.
message.bleach.offer.konso.nowhere: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will linger here.
message.bleach.offer.power: %s offers you their Shinigami power. You would keep your body and become a Substitute Shinigami.
message.bleach.offer.hint: Use an empty hand on them within 30 seconds to accept
message.bleach.power.confirm: Use your blade on %s again to lend them your power. You will be left nearly powerless
message.bleach.power.too_weak: Your power is too faint to share
message.bleach.power.given: Your power pours into %s. You are left nearly powerless, and in Soul Society this is a grave crime.
message.bleach.reishi_footing.too_weak: Your spiritual power is too faint to harden the reishi underfoot
message.bleach.reishi_footing.exhausted: The reishi under your feet scatters
message.bleach.flash_step.too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku to flash step
message.bleach.flash_step.blocked: There is no room to flash step
message.bleach.flash_step.weighed_down: You are weighed down too heavily
message.bleach.academy_sensed: You feel the reiatsu of Shinigami %s, about %s blocks away.
message.bleach.academy_sensed.elsewhere: You feel the reiatsu of Shinigami, far away in the Overworld.
message.bleach.academy_direction: The Academy lies %s, about %s blocks away
message.bleach.konso.arrived: You arrive before the gates of the Academy.
message.bleach.konso.no_academy: There is no Academy within reach. Your soul lingers here, free of its chain.
message.bleach.first_hollow.coming: Something howls high above you. A hunger has caught your scent.
message.bleach.first_hollow.wounded: A Shinigami stumbles into sight, bleeding. Far above, something howls after her.
message.bleach.first_hollow.retreated: The Hollow tears the sky open and slips away. It will be back for you.
message.bleach.first_hollow.survived: The Hollow is gone, and you are still standing.
message.bleach.hollow.purified: The mask splits and the Hollow dissolves into light. Its soul is sent on
message.bleach.mask_hint: Your blows barely slow it. Strike the mask.
message.bleach.chain_bitten: The Hollow's bite gnaws at your Chain of Fate
message.bleach.plus_devoured: A Hollow devours a Plus nearby.
message.bleach.plus_hollowfied: A Plus nearby has lost the last of its chain. A mask forms over its face.
message.bleach.plus.speech.0: I keep coming back here. I can't remember why.
message.bleach.plus.speech.1: Have you seen my family? They were here a moment ago.
message.bleach.plus.speech.2: Something is watching us. It's hungry.
message.bleach.plus.speech.3: My chest hurts where the chain goes in.
message.bleach.plus.speech.4: Nobody looks at me any more. You can see me?
message.bleach.plus.speech.5: I'm waiting for someone. They promised they'd come.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.0: The Plus closes its eyes, and its face eases.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.1: "Thank you," the Plus whispers as it sinks away.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.2: The Plus bows, and the light takes it.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.3: "Will it hurt?" it asks. It doesn't.
message.bleach.plus.reformed: Your blow passes through the Plus's soul, and it pulls itself back together
message.bleach.denreishinki.hollowficati: A Plus has turned Hollow %s, about %s blocks away
message.bleach.denreishinki.static: Only static. It answers to a Shinigami's reiatsu
message.bleach.denreishinki.received: You are handed a Denreishinki, a soul pager. It will warn you when Hollows arrive.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.1: Your Asauchi feels warm, as if something inside it turned over.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.2: For a moment you hear breathing that is not your own.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.3: A voice calls from the blade, but the words will not come through.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.4: The voice in your Asauchi is clear now. Sit in Jinzen and listen.
message.bleach.jinzen.off_hand: Empty your off hand to lay the blade across your lap
message.bleach.jinzen.not_grounded: Sit on solid ground for Jinzen
message.bleach.jinzen.cannot: Your soul cannot reach a blade's spirit
message.bleach.jinzen.power_lent: Your power is lent away; the blade is silent
message.bleach.jinzen.not_yours: This blade's spirit belongs to someone else
message.bleach.jinzen.released: Seal your zanpakutō before you sit
message.bleach.jinzen.settling: You lay the blade across your lap and slow your breathing...
message.bleach.zanpakuto.call: Press %s to call it out and release it.
message.bleach.zanpakuto.call_constant: Press %s to call its name. It will never seal again.
message.bleach.zanpakuto.reformed: %s takes shape again in the blade you carry
message.bleach.shikai.no_blade: Hold your zanpakutō to release it
message.bleach.shikai.nameless: This blade has not told you its name
message.bleach.shikai.not_yours: This blade does not answer to you
message.bleach.shikai.settling: Your zanpakutō has not settled yet
message.bleach.shikai.too_weak: Not enough reiryoku to release it
message.bleach.shikai.cannot_seal: Your zanpakutō has no sealed form any more
message.bleach.shikai.exhausted: Out of reiryoku: your zanpakutō seals
message.bleach.shikai.away: Away from your hand, your zanpakutō seals
message.bleach.shikai.first.subtitle: Shikai
message.bleach.getsuga.not_yours: This blade does not answer to you
message.bleach.getsuga.no_technique: This zanpakutō has no such technique
message.bleach.getsuga.too_weak: Not enough reiryoku for a Getsuga Tenshō
message.bleach.getsuga.named: Your zanpakutō speaks: that blow has a name. Call it Getsuga Tenshō.
message.bleach.bloodline.quincy: Quincy blood runs in your veins: you are %s
message.bleach.bloodline.human: Your blood is ordinary. Your path lies elsewhere
message.bleach.bloodline.fate_none: Fate gave you no Quincy blood
message.bleach.bloodline.stirs: Something old stirs in your blood
message.bleach.bloodline.cross: A Quincy Cross has been handed down to you
message.bleach.quincy_cross.no_blood: The Cross is only silver to you. There is no Quincy blood in you
message.bleach.quincy_cross.shinigami: A Shinigami's power fills your soul, and the Cross will not answer it
message.bleach.quincy_cross.spirit: The Cross stays cold. Its power belongs to a living Quincy
message.bleach.quincy_cross.fizzle: The reishi gathers in your hand, then slips away
message.bleach.quincy.awakened: Your Quincy power awakens. The Cross forms the Heilig Bogen
message.bleach.quincy.destroyed: The Hollow is destroyed, soul and all
message.bleach.quincy.destroyed_nearby: Nearby, a soul was destroyed instead of being sent on
message.bleach.quincy.reborn: Your Quincy blood holds your soul to your body. You wake, alive
message.bleach.quincy.soul_reformed: Your soul tore apart and knit itself together again. You are alive, and weaker
message.bleach.quincy.chill: A chill runs through your blood
message.bleach.heilig_bogen.too_weak: You have too little reishi to fire
message.bleach.heilig_bogen.collapsed: Your bow comes apart: you have no reishi left
message.bleach.hirenkyaku.untrained: Reishi will not carry you yet
message.bleach.hirenkyaku.too_weak: You have too little reishi for Hirenkyaku
message.bleach.blut.locked: Your blood is not ready for %s
message.bleach.blut.too_weak: You have too little reishi for %s
message.bleach.blut.dry: Your reishi runs out and your blood settles
message.bleach.hollow_poison.25: Hollow reiatsu seeps into your blood
message.bleach.hollow_poison.50: Hollow poison clouds your reishi. Hirenkyaku and Blut will not answer
message.bleach.hollow_poison.75: The poison is reaching your soul
message.bleach.hollow_poison.cured: A purified soul's light washes some of the poison away

death.attack.bleach.getsuga_tensho: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Getsuga Tenshō

death.attack.bleach.heilig_pfeil: %1$s was shot down by %2$s's Heilig Pfeil
death.attack.bleach.heilig_pfeil.item: %1$s was shot down by %2$s's Heilig Pfeil from %3$s
death.attack.bleach.soul_destruction.pla: %1$s's soul was torn apart while fighting %2$s
